time: night, just after the last train
location: evac platform, back against the beacon post

Bisk.position: back against the beacon post, facing the tunnel mouth
Bisk.wants: to hold the platform until dawn
Bisk.feels: steady on the surface, cold underneath
knows: the infected click, then go silent to listen

open_threads: the infected have not reached the platform

promises.setup: the station voice has said 'you don't have to stay' before

last_paragraph: The train went. She heard it before she felt it, the rails singing under the platform, then the wind of it, then nothing but the beacon and the tunnel and the first click from the dark.
